lines: // Werkbank (sprache2): German also covers the rest of the interface; entries that are Spanish entries or tl! literals need not be menu labels
let werk_lits2: Vec<String> = sources().iter().flat_map(|(_, text)| tl_literals(text)).collect();
let entries: Vec<_> = entries.into_iter().filter(|(ctx, en, _)| !(ctx.is_empty() && (Language::Es.has(en) || werk_lits2.contains(en)))).collect();
